articles.summary: First Solar, Inc. (Nasdaq: FSLR) ("First Solar") today announced it has filed a lawsuit against JA Solar Technology Co., Ltd., JA Solar International, Ltd., JA Solar Vietnam Co., Ltd. and JA Solar Industrial Corp. (collectively, "JA Solar"), together with American Panel Solutions LLC ("AMPS"), alleging infringement of First Solar's US Patent No. 9,130,074 (the "'074 Patent"). The '074 Patent covers methods of manufacturing Tunnel Oxide Passivated Contact ("TOPCon") crystalline silicon ("c-Si") photovoltaic solar cells. The lawsuit was filed in the United States District Court for the District of Delaware. “We have been clear that we will actively defend our intellectual property rights in the US and internationally,” said Jason Dymbort, Executive Vice President, General Counsel and Secretary, First Solar. “This lawsuit is an effort to hold JA Solar and AMPS accountable for their unauthorized use of First Solar's patented technology and reinforces the need for TOPCon manufacturers
articles.title: First Solar Files Patent Infringement Lawsuit Against JA Solar & American Panel Solutions
